_readme: S740 (the census's reconcile_steps lever, lane 1 `reconcile`): the catalog's own words for a correction step, read as the capture reads the page (capture_view), free, no model call, nothing written. Solano: the 2026-27 catalog PDF prints sociology under SOCI where the state's file lists SOC, and two records' notes say the course descriptions print '(Formerly SOC 0xx)'; this read prints those lines. It also prints the Psychology A.A.-T and Social Work and Human Services A.A.-T sections, whose records read no major total.

questions.formerly: Which SOCI courses does the catalog print as formerly SOC, and under which titles?
